Department:  Emergency Department

 Shift:  Nights

 Daily Work Times:  7:00 p.m. - 7:30 a.m.

 Scheduled Hours per Pay:  72

Position Summary:

Responsible for assessing physiological, emotional, and spiritual needs of each patient within assigned unit area and planning nursing care to meet those needs.Responsible to see that nursing care plans are carried out through performance and/or leadership of subordinate personnel.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Adheres to standards of nursing practice of McLaren Regional Medical Center, which consists of systematic approach to nursing practice by using nursing process.Assesses and documents patient’s status on admission and continuously thereafter.Develops written plan of care, including long and short range goals and nursing actions.

Qualifications:

Required:

 2 years of related formal education/training beyond high school required. Licensed to practice as a Registered Nurse in State of Michigan . BCLS ACLS certification within 6 months of hire.

Preferred:

 6 months to 1 year of job related experience.
